nota: Python: valida o JWT com PyJWKClient antes de usar o e-mail.
codigo:
import jwt
from jwt import PyJWKClient

CERTS = PyJWKClient(f"https://{TIME}.cloudflareaccess.com/cdn-cgi/access/certs")

def usuario_do_access(request):
    email = request.headers.get("Cf-Access-Authenticated-User-Email")
    token = request.headers.get("Cf-Access-Jwt-Assertion")
    chave = CERTS.get_signing_key_from_jwt(token)
    dados = jwt.decode(token, chave.key, algorithms=["RS256"], audience=AUD, issuer=ISSUER)
    return email if dados["email"] == email else None
